test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Shital covers a certain distance in 9 hours at the speed of 40 km/h. If she wants to cover the same distance in 6 hours, then by how much will she have to increase her speed (in km/h)?
solution:
**Given:**

Shital covers a certain distance in 9 hours at the speed of 40 km/h.

**Concept used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Total distance = 9 × 40

⇒ 360 km

Now,

To cover this in 6 hours her speed will be = 360/6

⇒ 60 km/h

Speed increased = 60 - 40

⇒ 20

**∴ The required answer is 20.**
